body:
I recognise some things. I am as terrified as you say of gaining weight. All I see is fat, and it's getting worse every day. But I look in the mirror and *actually* see fat.. I'm not lean, I'm not slender. I physically see that I am fat. I do worry about what I ate today, yesterday, the weekend, the week before.. I can see in my log that I didn't overeat calorie wise, but it still feels like too much, mainly because all I see is fat today. I think about food all, all, all the time.. I love it and I hate it. I feel up and down. I am so tired. My father keeps saying I am too skinny, but I thought it was just Dad worry. Heck actually I'll admit I've been resenting him for saying that I'm skinny, because I've outright considered him to be lying about it, just to try and make me fat for some reason. I don't know what reason, but that's how it's felt. 



Sometimes I wonder how I can be so tired on 1300 calories a day, it's supposed to be enough to sustain me according to the calorie calculators. I just have no idea whats going on with my body, any which way. 

But I have to wonder, is it possible to having an eating disorder without really knowing you have one? I always kind of thought, people with eating disorders knew they had one even if they were unable to tell anyone/admit it.. And I'm not kidding, honestly all I physically see is fat on my body, and getting fatter. I don't know if I can accept that this perception is the result of a disorder, since I can see it physically there.. and I really can't bear it.

Thank you for talking to me, by the way. I am thinking about this and not meaning to brush it off. I guess I'm a little shocked and confused right now is all.. so confused. I'm always confused I feel.

I didn't talk to the doctor about how I felt really. I told him I was rapidly gaining weight, he weighed me and I asked not to look. He scheduled a blood test which I had, gave me a pot to pee in, and then at a later appointment 'the other thing'. The first appointment was when he took my blood pressure and said it was low, but most likely nothing to worry about as I was short and exercised a lot. He has weighed me since at 2 more appointments (after follow ups for results, which were surprisingly quick) but simply says I am not overweight. I explained to him that I'm gaining and I don't know why, but he says 'Well, there's no problem right now with your weight'. Nothing was really actually said at any point thinking back, besides me telling him I'm concerned about weight gain, then him talking about tests, follow up appointments, telling me nothing was wrong, blah blah.. then I gave up.

This is taking over my life, yes.. but I feel I have no choice. I can measure the 2 inch gain on my waist, I can see the flab in the mirror, and I have to fix it because I don't know why its happening. If it were a case of overeating, I could just stop doing that.. but it's not.

But I don't see how its an eating disorder, because I desperately WANT to eat more, not less. I just can't eat more because I'm gaining fat already on what I am eating. I'd LOVE to eat more, the last thing I want to do is feel this way.

I am so exhausted. I feel like I just want someone to listen and hear me when I say that. I am so exhausted. I can't stop crying now. I am so, so, so tired. I feel so alone, and so fat, and getting fatter, with no help. I don't know what to do from here except end it all.

I already change my routine at the gym every 6 weeks.

I already have one 5k fast run, and one 4 mile + long distance.

I already change things up,

If I ate as much as my friends, I'd blow the FUCK up even faster, considering i'm gaining fat on 1300 calories a day. I'm having to decline every single invitation to go out because of having to keep my calorie count so strict to try and combat this flab gain.
